explanation: The common ancestors of the eukaryotic supergroups were the first Eukaryotes. Eukaryotic supergroups are positioned above the Kingdom level of classification. Land plants belong to the Archaeplastida supergroup. Both Fungi and Animals are classified within the Opisthokonta supergroup. This shared evolutionary lineage indicates that Fungi and Animals are more closely related to each other than animals are to plants.

questions.q: Under which supergroup are plants classified?
questions.exp: According to the slide, 'Plants fall under Archaeplastida Supergroup'.

questions.q: Which organisms are more closely related according to eukaryotic supergroup classification?
questions.exp: The notes state: 'Fungi and Animals more closely related than animals and plants' because they both fall under the Opisthokonta supergroup.
